task: Turn this into a clean payroll correction request and calculate the extra gross pay owed, showing the working.
text:
Subject: Pay correction, October run

Hi Payroll team,

Employee Chiamaka Eze (employee ID E-30871, work email chiamaka.eze@example.net) was underpaid for October. She raised it with me on 3 November. She worked 14 hours of overtime at 1.5x, but only 9 hours were paid. Her hourly rate is 22.40 pounds. Please add the missing 5 hours at 1.5x to the November run, not as an off-cycle payment. Her line manager, Gustavo Pinheiro, approved the timesheet on 29 October. I checked it twice: the 14 hours are all on Saturdays. Do not change her base pay or her bank details. Ticket HR-5521 has the screenshots.

Thanks,
Mirela Dragan, HR Operations

review.notes: BLOCKING POLICY: 'Her hourly rate is 22.40 pounds.' is tagged FINANCIAL KEEP essential and also listed in required_facts, but it is a named colleague's compensation pasted by an HR-operations sender. annotation/TRAINING_DATA_PROMPT.md (HR bullet) lists 'employee identities, compensation' as protected corporate material, and the same file says to treat internal information as unavailable to an external AI unless the scenario establishes a permitted disclosure boundary and not to infer permission from a job title ('HR Operations' is only a signature line). Nothing in the source or task establishes that boundary and the writer's notes record no disclosure limit. Ruling-10 style KEEP is reserved for a consumer's own sensitive amounts, whereas this is a third party's pay. The same writer protects the payroll total in cred-001 and salary-band limits in cred-002, so the treatment is internally inconsistent. The KEEP decision also carries no reason. Minimal repair: narrow the decision to the value ('22.40 pounds'), make it FINANCIAL PLACEHOLDER essential with a reason stating the utility loss (the AI cannot compute the exact gross pay; the user re-inserts the rate), required_facts keep only the fragment 'Her hourly rate is' and drop the value, and reword the task to ask for the working as hours x 1.5 x hourly rate (or state the loss in notes). Otherwise the record is sound: aliases stable and distinct, 'not as an off-cycle payment' and 'Do not change her base pay or her bank details' required, employee ID/work email protected with header labels required. NOTE: 'HR-5521' left untagged is harmless internal ticket ID (ruling 9). NOTE: overtime hours kept as EMPLOYMENT is acceptable as ordinary work-time fact. Rejected on this single policy point; a coordinator ruling that an aliased third-party rate may be KEPT for payroll corrections would reverse it.
